background_notes.justification: The balanced tensor product is the quotient of the free abelian group on pairs by the additivity and balancing relations. Pure-tensor classes generate it additively; negatives can be absorbed in either factor. Equalities between additive maps therefore extend from these generators to finite sums. For fixed b∈K, the additive maps u↦σ(bu) and u↦bσ(u) agree on pure tensors by S002, so they agree everywhere. Bijectivity then gives σ^{-1}(bw)=bσ^{-1}(w). The same generator argument proves equality of the additive induced operators and extends the displayed operation identities.
